checks.name: Every existing effect has a keyframe control
Two depth keys interpolate controls and actual rendered pixels
Ease in/out and Hold evaluate in the preview
Keys can be retimed/deleted and time collisions are rejected
Discrete sampling uses Hold and rebuilds only on value changes
Camera poses create and retain five animation tracks
Previous/next key navigation moves the playhead
Clip cannot be shortened past its last key
Project save/open preserves animation and camera keys
Earlier projects open with a fresh timeline
Malformed animation cannot replace the current project
Recording resets to zero, locks edits and saves automatically at the clip end
Downloaded video decodes and contains the keyframed opacity change
Preview loop wraps without ending playback

limits: Headless Chromium; broad browser/hardware and long captures unverified.
Live capture pacing is browser-dependent and video is silent.
